name: vinall-app
description: Capacitor wrapper for VINALL. Lives in app/ so the repo root stays flat and Vercel's zero-config deploy is untouched.

scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.assets: node scripts/make-assets.mjs && npx @capacitor/assets generate --iconBackgroundColor "#0a0908" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#0a0908" --splashBackgroundColor "#0a0908" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#0a0908" && node scripts/trim-splash.mjs
